name: @geohar/un-bien-monorepo
description: un-bien monorepo: native iOS/macOS client (app/), pi extension (extension/), and relay (relay/). Derived from remote-pi (Jacob Moura) — see extension/relay for origin history + license.

scripts.build: pnpm -C extension build && pnpm -C launcher build && pnpm -C unbien-cli build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C extension typecheck && pnpm -C launcher typecheck && pnpm -C unbien-cli typecheck && pnpm -C web-client exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm -C extension test && pnpm -C unbien-cli test && pnpm -C web-client test
scripts.test:scripts: for f in scripts/*.test.sh; do bash "$f" || exit 1; done
